About CosplayVault

CosplayVault is a premium cosplay photography gallery featuring talented cosplayers from around the world.

Our platform connects cosplay artists with fans who appreciate the craft, dedication, and artistry that goes into every costume and photoshoot.

', 'About CosplayVault — Premium Cosplay Gallery', 'Learn about CosplayVault, the premium cosplay photography gallery featuring talented cosplayers worldwide.', 'published'), ('privacy', 'Privacy Policy', '

Last updated: January 2026

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, subscribe to VIP membership, or contact us for support.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, and send you technical notices and support messages.

Content Policy

All content on CosplayVault is owned by the respective creators. Unauthorized reproduction or distribution is prohibited.

Subscription Terms

VIP subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.

', 'Terms of Service — CosplayVault', 'CosplayVault terms of service — rules and guidelines for using our platform.', 'published'), ('contact', 'Contact Us', '

Contact Us

We would love to hear from you. Reach out to us through any of the channels below.

General Inquiries

For general questions about CosplayVault, please email us at hello@cosplayvault.com

VIP Support

VIP members receive priority support. Please include your account email in all correspondence.

Content Submissions

Interested in featuring your cosplay on CosplayVault? Contact us at submissions@cosplayvault.com

', 'Contact CosplayVault', 'Contact the CosplayVault team for support, inquiries, or content submissions.', 'published'), ('dmca', 'DMCA Policy', '

  • A description of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed
  • The URL or location of the allegedly infringing material
  • Your contact information
  • A statement that you have a good faith belief that the use is not authorized
  • Your physical or electronic signature

DMCA Agent

Email: dmca@cosplayvault.com
